About Infectious Diseases in Bhiwandi

Infectious diseases arise from bacteria, viruses, fungi, or other microbes that can affect different parts of the body. These conditions may involve the respiratory tract, urinary system, digestive organs, skin, or bloodstream. Early assessment, correct diagnosis, appropriate treatment, and careful follow-up are important for recovery and to reduce the risk of complications.

Common Signs of Infection

Fever, chills, or body ache
Cough, sore throat, or breathing difficulty
Burning, pain, or urinary symptoms
Skin rash or wound infection
Diarrhoea, vomiting, or dehydration
Sudden weakness, confusion, or severe fatigue

When to Consult a Doctor

  • High fever or fever that does not settle
  • Difficulty breathing or chest pain
  • Confusion, severe weakness, or dehydration
  • Uncontrolled vomiting or severe diarrhoea
  • Worsening rash, swelling, or wound infection
  • Symptoms that progressively worsen or do not improve
